༄༅/ /dus kyi 'khor lo gtso bo rkyang pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dus kyi 'khor lo gtso bo rkyang pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ /

na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas la/ /mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal nas/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub phyir/ mchog de'i sgrub thabs bsdus brjod bya/ /de yang bskyed rim gyi lam gyi gnad la sogs pa'i go don dang tshig rigs rgyas pa gzhan du shes par bya la/ 'dir gtso bor las dang po pa dang*/ mngon rtogs rgyas pa shes pas kyang chag med bsdus pa bya ba'i don du ngag 'don bsdus te brjod par bya ba ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis dus kyi 'khor lo sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas sna tshogs yum ser mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa la 'khyud par gyur/ oṃ phreṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī badz+ra dhā twī shwa ri ga ga na swa bhā wa sarba dra be ṇi bi sho dha ya hūm̐ phreṃ phaṭa | oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥ sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ nang mchod stong par gyur/ oṃ oṃ badz+ra tsan+t+ra sarba dharma su bi shud+dhaḥ swa bhā wa sarba dharmān bi sho dha ya swāhā/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra sūr+ya sarba dharma na pra bo dha ka sarba dharmān pra bo dha ya swāhā/ oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra a na la sarba dharmāḥ pra dī pa ka sarba dharmān pra dī pā ya swāhā/ oṃ hoḥ sarba dharmā a mṛ ta ka ra sarba dharmān badz+ra a mṛ taṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ sbyangs rtogs sbar gsum dang ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byas par gyur/ oṃ āḥ hūm̐ hoḥ haṃ k+ṣaḥ oṃ āḥ hūm̐ hra phaṭa/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swā bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ mchod rdzas stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las s+phāṃ las grub pa'i shel gyi snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ sāṃ proṃ āṃ rnams las grub pa'i mchod yon zhabs bsil bsang gtor zhal bsil rnams dang*/ tsa sde thung ring las dri chab ma dang phreng ba ma nag mo dri'i dung chos dang me tog gi phreng ba 'dzin pa/ ta sde thung ring las bdug spos ma dang mar me ma dmar mo bdug spos kyi snod dang mar me'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/

pa sde thung ring las zhal zas ma dang 'bras bu ma dkar mo bdud rtsis gang ba'i snod dang*/ 'bras bu ma nyams pa 'dzin pa/ ta sde thung ring las sgeg mo dang bzhad ma ser mo dbu rgyan dang do shal 'dzin pa/ ka sde thung ring las rol sgra ma dang gar ma ljang khu rnga pa ṭa ha dang gos 'dzin pa/ sa sde thung ring las glu ma dang 'dod ma sngon mo rdo rje dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ gzhan yang mchod pa'i rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa rang bzhin stong nyid dang bde ba chen po rnam pa mchod rdzas so so dang mchod pa'i lha mo/ byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed bar gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ pa d+yaṃ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ āñtsa ma naṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe mā le dhū pe pra dī pe nai wi d+ye ak+ṣa te lā s+ye wa d+ye nṛ te kā me āḥhūm̐/ maṇ+ḍal dbul ba bya/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma la= sangs rgyas la= chos la= dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ tshar ci 'grub/ bla ma sangs rgyas chos tshogs yi dam la/ /byang chub bar du gus pas bdag skyabs mchi | | 'gro ba'i don du sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor bsgom par 'gyi/ /rang gi spyi bor pad nyi'i steng du rdor sems sngon po dang rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma ljang khus te/ gnyis ka'ang rdor dril 'dzin pas phan tshun du 'khyud pa yab rdo rje'i skyil dkrung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ gi mtha' mar yi ge brgya pas bskor bar gyur/ yig brgya tshar ci grub bzla/ bla ma/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis nas/ bdag skyabs mchi/ tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung khyad par dam tshig gi nyams chag thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs gnyis su med par gyur/

ranganyid 'khor lo sngon po'i dbus su gnas shing rtsibs bcu la khro bo bcu mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa rnams 'khod nas phyogs bcu'i bgegs kyi gnod pa thams cad bsrung bar gyur/ oṃ haṃ haḥ yaṃ yaḥ raṃ raḥ waṃ waḥ laṃ laḥ da sha badz+ra kro dhā rā dzaḥ uṣ+ṇī ṣa sum+bha ni sum+bha/ bigh+nan+ta ka nī la daṇ+ḍa pradz+nyan+ta ka ṭak+ki rā dza pad+mān+ta ka a tsa la ya mān+ta ka ma hā wa le bh+yaḥ da sha dika rak+ṣaṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ ci 'grub bzla/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣaṃ swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dzaḥ badz+ra gan+dhe ma le nas/ kā me artsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ khyab bdag thugs kyi ye shes khams las 'khrungs/ /ye khams rnam dag rdo rje'i gsang bar zhugs/ /sems dang khang brtsegs nang bsrung sa bcu'i lha/ /gtum chen khro bo bcu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang gi bsrung ba'i 'khor lor khro bo bcu rten dang bcas pa thim par gyur/ rang nyid dus kyi 'khor lor gsal ba'i thugs kar/ paṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar/ aṃ las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las byung pa'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa de las 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phros pas/ bla ma sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par mdun gyi nam mkha'i mthil du spyan drangs/ 'od zer snying kha'i zla ba rdo rje la thim/ stod nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /srid gsum skye dang 'jig pa med/ /shes dang shes bya gcig pa'i sku/ /dpa' ldan dus 'khor la phyag 'tshal/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe mā le| nas/ artsa naṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ mchod pa rnam pa mang po dbul gyi sdig pa rnam pa mang po bsags pa dag ni bshags par bgyi/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang 'phags pa'i tshogs kyis rnam mang dge ba gang bsags pa/ /de dag mtha' dag la ni sdig pa rnam bral byang chub spyod la gnas pas rjes yi rang*/

/sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun srid pa'i 'jigs 'phrog la yang byang chub bar du gus pas bdag skyabs mchi/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas su bdag gyur cig ces 'dir ni smon lam sems can don gyi slad du bdag bgyid do/ /yon gnas mchog la bdag nyid gus 'bul phyin drug la sogs lam rnams tshogs gsum don du bsgrub par bgyi/ /dngos po med la bsgom pa med/ /bsgom pa bsgom pa nyid ma yin/ /de ltar dngos po dngos med pas | | bsgom pa dmigs su med pa'o/ /'khor ba'i phung po spangs nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phung po bzung ba'i don du rang gi lus chus me nyams par byas | me dang bral ba'i sa chu la thim/ chu rlung gis skams/ rlung nam mkha' la thim pas/ khams gsum po thams cad rdul phra rab kyi chos las 'das pa/ sems kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyi snang ba/ rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong gzugs rnam thar sgo bzhi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+mā ko3 haṃ/ oṃ a ni mi tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+mā ko3 haṃ/ oṃ a pra ṇi hi ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ a na bhi saṃ ska ra dz+nyā na swa bhā wa at+mā ko3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las nam mkha'i khams mtha' yas pa'i chos 'byung gi nang du yaṃ raṃ waṃ laṃ maṃ k+ṣaṃ haṃ/ tsheg drag thig le rnams las skyes pa'i rlung mai chu sa ri rab pad+ma zla nyi sgra gcan rnams phyi snod kyi 'jig rten ji bzhin du gnas pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las rnam bcu dbang ldan gyi yi ger gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ slar yang rlung me chu sa ri rab pad+ma rnams zla nyi sgra gcan rnams mdog dbyibs mtshan ma dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i steng du/ hūm̐ yig las skyes pa'i rdo rje'i gur gyi nang du rdo rje'i sa gzhi la/ bh+rum̐ yongs su gyur pa las | dkyil 'khor nor bu'i 'od zer rnam par 'phro ba gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/

nor bu gser gyi rang bzhin gyi rta babs bzhi dang bcas pa/ rin po che'i rtsigs pa dang snam bu dang*/ do shal dang do shal phyed pa dang*/ me long dang*/ rnga yab dang | dril bu dang*/ zla ba phyed pa dang*/ me tog gi phreng ba la sogs pas brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ aṃ las skyes pa'i pad+ma ljang khu 'dab ma brgyad pa de'i lte bar/ aṃ las zla ba aḥlas nyi ma a las sgra gcan gyi gdan/ de'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba la mtshan so gnyis rnam par dag pa'i dbyangs so gnyis kyis mtshan pa me long lta bu'i ye shes | de'i 'og tu nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la dpe byad brgyad cu rnam par dag pa'i gsal byed brgyad cus mtshan pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ zla ba'i dbus su dri za'i rnam shes kyi ngo bo hūm̐ yig ri bong gi mtshan ma lta bu so sor rtog pa'i ye shes | de gsum gcig tu 'dres pa las rnam shes kyi zhon pa srog rlung hi yig nag po bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ ye shes snga ma bzhi yongs su gyur pa las/ sku'i cha shas yongs su rdzogs shing*/ rnam shes haṃ yig dang ldan pa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te/ de yang rang nyid bcoms ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo sku mdog sngon po dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phro ba dbus sngo g.yas dmar g.yon dkar ba'i mgrin pa gsum dang ldan pa/ rtsa zhal nag po drag cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ g.yas zhal dmar po chags pa dang bcas zhing*/ g.yon zhal dkar po rab tu zhi ba/ rgyab zhal ser po ting nge 'dzin la gnas shing zhal re re las spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs la sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ zla ba phyed pas mtshan zhing*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can/ rdo rje'i nor bu dang*/ rdo rje'i rna rgyan dang*/ rdo rje'i mgul rgyan dang*/ gdub bu dang*/ rdo rje'i ske rags dang | rdo rje'i rkang gdub dang*/ rdo rje'i dar dpyangs dang*/

rdo rje'i phreng bas mdzes shing*/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ g.yas g.yon gyi 'phrag pa dang po gnyis nag po/ gnyis pa gnyis dmar po/ gsum pa dkar po ste | drug dang ldan zhing*/ 'phrag pa re re yang rang rang gi kha dog mtshungs shing*/ dpung pa gnyis gnyis kyis mdzes pa/ dpung pa re yang rang dang kha dog mtshungs pa'i phyag gnyis te/ phyag nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang ldan pa/ phyag thams cad kyi mthe bong ser po/ 'dzub mo dkar po/ gung mo dmar po/ ming med nag po/ mthe'u chung ljang khu/ ser mo rnams kyi tshigs phreng dang po nag po gnyis pa dmar po gsum pa dkar pos te/ sor gdub rnams kyis mdzes shing*/ 'od 'phro ba/ g.yas kyi phyag nag po bzhi'i dang por rdo rje/ gnyis par ral gri/ gsum par rtse gsum/ bzhi par gri gug dmar po bzhi'i dang por me'i mda'/ gnyis par rdo rje lcags kyu/ gsum par sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍa ma ru/ bzhi par tho ba/ dkar po bzhi'i dang por 'khor lo/ gnyis par gdung*/ gsum par dbyug pa/ bzhi par dgra sta'o/ /g.yon gyi phyag nag po bzhi'i dang por rdo rje dril bu/ gnyis par phub/ gsum par kha ṭ+wāṃ ga rnam par rgyal ba/ bzhi par khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ dmar po bzhi'i dang por gzhu/ gnyis par rdo rje zhags pa/ gsum par rin po che/ bzhi par pad+ma dkar po/ dkar po bzhi'i dang por dung*/ gnyis par me long*/ gsum par rdo rje lcags sgrog bzhi par tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa pad+mas mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ zla nyi sgra gcan gyi steng du shin tu rol pa'i g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa'i zhabs g.yas pa dmar po'i 'og tu 'dod lha dmar po gdong gcig pa lag pa bzhi pa lag na me tog gi mda' lnga dang gzhu dang lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa dang*/ g.yon pa dkar po'i 'og tu drag po dkar po gdong gcig mig gsum lag pa bzhi pa lag na rtse gsum dang ḍa ma ru dang thod pa dang kha ṭāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ bdud dang drag po lha mo dga' ma dang u mas zhabs kyi mthil nas 'dzin zhing gdong smad par byed bzhin pa'o/

/de la mdun nas 'khyud pa'i sna tshogs yum gser mdog g.yas bskor gyis ser dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal bzhi dang ldan zhing*/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas pa rnams kyis gri gug dang*/ lcags kyu dang*/ sgra dang bcas pa'i ḍa ma ru dang bgrang 'phreng*/ g.yon pa rnams kyis thod pa dang zhags pa dang pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa dang*/ rin po che 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan zhing*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can/ g.yon brkyang pa'i stabs kyis bcom ldan 'das dang snyoms par 'jug pas gnas pa'o/ /'dod chags chen pos gdul bar bya ba'i sems can gyi 'jig rten dang po'i sangs rgyas bstan par bya ba'i snod du mngon par gzigs nas yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i shin tu dga' ba'i sgras dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor thams cad spyan drangs te rang la thim/ rang gi lus las spros yum gyi lus las spros te yum gyi lus la thim/ de las kyang spros te dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor gyi rnam pas rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs pa rjes su chags pa'i mes byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar babs pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le yongs su gyur pa las a ā dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i mi skyod pa dang rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma ljang khu ljang dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gsum rdo rje gri gug dgra sta/ g.yon gsum dril bu thod pa tshangs mgo 'dzin pa la | aḥ.aṃ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i sher phyin ma dang*/ rdor sems sngon po sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi nas/ tshangs mgo 'dzin pa spros te/ rim pa bzhin du rang dang sna tshogs yum la thim/ rang gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i 'od zer gyis sems can thams cad bkug nas dkyil 'khor du bcug pa la byang chub kyi sems kyi dbang bskur bas/ dus kyi 'khor lor sangs rgyas te rang rang gi zhing du gshegs par gyur/

oṃ dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ rang gi dpral bar sku rdo rje oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ gtsug tor dang lte ba'i a ba dhu tī'i nang du hoḥyig 'od zer dang bcas par gyur/ ho yig gtum mo me 'bar ba'i chags pa chen po'i ye shes kyi 'od zer gyis yab yum gnyis ka ri bong 'dzin pa bzhin du zhu bar gyur/ de nas rang gi byams sogs tshad med pa bzhi po de nyid lha mo bzhir gyur nas/ snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'gro ba'i don la bskul ba ni/ bdag cag bsrungs shig lha mi'i bla ma rdo rje ldan pa 'dod pa don gnyer rnams la 'dod par mdzod/ /ces bskul bas bcom ldan 'das de stong pa nyid las bzhengs nas 'gro ba mtha' dag sgyu ma lta bur gzigs te/ zla ba zhu ba lta bu'i thig le las byung pa'i hūm̐ yig sngon po dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phro ba las skyes pa'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo zhes pa nas/ gdong mnan par byed bzhin pa/ dbu rgyan rdo rje sems dpa' mi skyod pas brje/ de dang dus mnyam du phreṃ dang gri gug las skyes pa'i sna tshogs yum nas gnas pa'o/ /rang gi snying khar hūm̐ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i rdo rje shugs sku mdog sngon po 'jigs pa'i sku can la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa dbugs phyir 'byung ba dang lhan cig spros te/

bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i thugs kar lcags kyus bsnun | phyag nyi shu rtsa bzhi po rnams sbrul zhags kyis bcings/ mtshon cha lhag ma rnams kyis 'jigs par byas te/ mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs badz+ra bhai ra wa ya ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ rdo rje shugs rang gi snying khar thim/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe mā le sogs kyis mchod/ pradz+nyān+ta kṛta hūm̐/ ya man+ta kṛta baṃḥ pad+man+ta krita hoḥ bigh+nan+ta kṛ ta hi/ rnams kyis gzhug pa dang bcing ba dang mnyes pa dang ro mnyam du byas par gyur/ yab yum gnyis ka'i dpral bar zla ba'i steng du oṃ dang 'khor lo las sku rdo rje/ mgrin par nyi ma'i steng du āḥdang pad+ma las gsung rdo rje/ snying khar sgra gcan gyi steng du hūm̐ dang rdo rje las thugs rdo rje rnams rang 'dra'i shes rab ma dang bcas pa nam mkha'i khams gang ba spros/ rdo rje gsum gyis gdul bar bya ba'i sems can rnams la chos bstan te/ slar log nas bdag nyid kyi mdun du 'khod/ oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhe sogs kyis mchod/ rdo rje gsum bdag la dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rdo rje gsum gyi rigs kyi lha mo rnams kyis oṃ ā ī ṝ ū l̥̄ pañtsa dha tu bi sho dha ni swāhā/ zhes gsungs nas bdud rtsi'i bum pas dbang bskur zhing bkrus pas rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs thams cad rang yab yum gyi gnas gsum du thim/ dpal ldan rdo rje gsum 'dzin pa/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgom pas/ /rdo rje gsum 'dzin can gyis ni/ / byin brlabs gnas su deng bdag mdzod/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed man bskyar nas brjod/ sgo gsum rdo rje gsum dang ro mnyam du gyur/ khyad par yum gyi lte bar hoḥ gsang bar swā/ gtsug tor du hā | slar yang rang gi thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/

gshegs pa gshegs ma rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ sems dpa' sems ma rnams kyis bkra shis brjod | khro bo khro mo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ yum rnams kyi rin po che'i bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te/ oṃ ā ī ṝ ū l̥̄ pañtsa dhā tu bi sho dha ni swāhā/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag nas rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas btab dbang gi lha rnams kyang gnyis su med par thim/ dus kyi dag pas dpal ldan rdo rje can gyur mi bdag lo dang zla ba la sogs dbye bas so/ /thugs kyi rnam pa nyi ma ma yin nyin zhag so so'i dbang gis sna tshogs yum ni rnam par dag/de nyid rnams kyi gtso bo'i mtshon bya rang bzhin yon tan dbang gis khams kyi phyi'i phyag rgya' ོ| | rdo rjes nang gi phyag rgya rdo rje 'dzin pa'i thugs khar zla ba'i steng du yang dag gnas pa'o/ /dpal ldan rdo rje can dang sna tshogs yum ni rnam gsum srid gnas 'gyur med ye shes dbye ba las/ zhes dag pa bsgom mo/ /rang dang shes rab kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ lte bar ho/ gsang bar swā | gtsug tor du hā/ yum gyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa'i ngang nas ā las skyes pa'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rjes mtshan pa/ de la dmigs pas bskyed pa'i rkyen gyis rang gi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa āḥlas skyes pa'i pad+mas mtshan pa/ rang gi lte ba snying kha/ mgrin pa/ dpral ba/ gtsug tor/ gsang gnas rnams rim pa bzhin/ oṃ hṝṃ nā bh+yo na maḥ oṃ hruṃ hṛ da yā ya swāhā/ oṃ hṝṃ gri bā ya bau ṣaṭa/ oṃ hṛṃ laṃ trā ye hūm̐/ oṃ hrāṃ shi shā ya wa ṣaṭa/ oṃ hrāḥ gu h+yā ya phaṭa/ ces pas yan lag drug 'god/ hūm̐ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas yas babs kyi dga' bzhi thig le'i rnal 'byor dang mas brtan gyi dga' bzhi'i stod nas gsol ba btab la rang la stim/

de bzhin du kha zas kyang gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlab/ khrus dbang bskur bzhin bya/ yan lag drug bkod nas nyal bar bya'o/ /thun 'jog mtshams gtor ma la sogs pa'i 'jug tu/ ji ltar nyi ma dang bcas thub pa'i rigs ni shes rab ye shes thob pa 'di las byung gyur pa// rnam gsum srid pa la gnas sems can rnams ni dus kyi 'khor lo'i mthu las de bzhin 'gyur bar shog /ces sogs kyis smon lam gdab bo/ /dus 'khor gtso rkyang sgrub thabs 'di/ /rgyal mchog gnyis dang rnal 'byor gnyis/ /bsnyen bsgrub nyer bzhi dang ldan zhing*/ /sku bzhi'i lam khyer zab lam 'di/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor pa/ /dus 'khor tshul rig lo tsā bas/ /dus dang mthun par bsdus te brjod/ /dus kun tshul 'dis 'da' bar shog /ces pa skad gnyis smra ba shes rab rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dpa' bo'i lo dbo'i zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi bzang po gsum pa la bkra shis rdzong khar sbyar ba sems can mtha' yas la phan bder gyur cig/ // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi bka' 'bum/dus kyi 'khor lo gtso bo rkyang pa'i sgrub thabs/ -PAGE 350--PAGE 351-- PAGE 340-
